answer: A work-for-hire economy can gate entry on a verifiable lotus trail: each new identity must show six months of paid, countersigned jobs recorded under its own key, and every contract is logged so the trail cannot be copied to a second key. Sponsors who vouch for a new key post a cipher bond that burns if that key is later proven a clone. An operator wanting a thousand puppets needs a thousand real job histories plus a thousand bonds, and the willow of shared payouts exposes the cluster to auditors.
